findings.label: DEMO_USERS bundled in production
findings.detail: AuthContext.jsx exports DEMO_USERS with plaintext demo passwords. This module ships in every production bundle until replaced with a real API. The TODO comment documents the gap; track it as a required pre-production action.

findings.detail: HomePage.jsx STATS array and SignInPage.jsx bottom stats display specific revenue and machine-uptime figures (₹18.4L Sep revenue, 94.2%) as if live. Replace with real API data or label as demo/sample before public exposure.
